# The Hero's Edge

A plain-looking blade waiting for the right hand — and the right deed to earn its name.

**Read-Aloud**: *The sword is unremarkable: a worn grip, a blade gone grey. Yet when offered to one who has proven worthy, the steel flushes warm, and a name not your own whispers along the edge — the name of every hero who bore it before.*

**Properties**: Starts as a +1 longsword. Gains +1 (max +3) per great deed performed by its wielder (DM discretion). While at max bond, grants Heroism (1/minute, 1d8 temp HP + advantage on fear saves).
**Lore**: Forged to be *earned*, not found; many false claimants have carried it as dead weight. A hidden verse names the deed that will complete it.
**Hooks**: The party must perform the deed to unlock it, a pretender wields a forgery, the sword refuses a corrupt bearer.
